* data generated with DIRAC (LL/B3LYP/Def2-TZVP)
  * all grid functions were calculated analytically, then exported on grid (in grid_3d.h5)
* cube grid with spacing=0.5 a.u. and margins=4.0 a.u. around the molecule
* molecular structure taken from kumar.etal_jpca_2017 (https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/acs.jpca.7b07607; molecule 2; B3LYP(Gaussian)/6-31G(d)); transformed to a.u.
